title: MenuBar: dropdown item clicks never fire (mousedown unmounts item before click)
description: All menu items under File/Edit/View/Insert/etc. close the menu but never run their action, in all browsers. Root cause: the dropdown renders inside the top-level menu div which has onMouseDown={isOpen ? onClose : onOpen} (MenuBar.tsx:145); mousedown on a dropdown item bubbles to the parent, onClose unmounts the dropdown before mouseup, so the item onClick (the only caller of item.action()) never fires. Fix: stop mousedown propagation at the dropdown container so pressing an item does not toggle the parent; keep click-outside close (document mousedown listener already uses ref.contains). Verify by driving the app.
